about_the_game:
A fast-paced, addictive parry-action combat system fused with strategic deckbuilding.
This single-player real-time action game is designed for fans of intense action and competitive play. Every opponent you face is a boss-level threat.
Build mana through well-timed parries, then unleash powerful attacks using your cards.

The game features five difficulty settings, ranging from Rookie to Master.
The highest level, Master, is designed to challenge even the most dedicated action and competitive players—clearing it is a true achievement.

At the same time, players who want to enjoy the unique systems and story at their own pace can choose from a variety of difficulty options.
Each level is carefully balanced, and your results are saved separately, allowing you to clearly track your growth and improvement as you play.

Duel Mode comes with pre-built decks, allowing you to jump straight into the action.
It’s perfect for players who want quick sessions or those aiming to master every enemy attack with flawless parries.

Tournament Mode lets you build your strategy from the cards and accessories you’re dealt, taking on consecutive battles as you fight your way toward the championship.
This mode offers a rogue-like experience with a fresh challenge every run.

Set in a near-future fantasy world where magic, swords, guns, and machines coexist, the story explores each witch’s reasons for entering the tournament and the relationships they forge with their rivals along the way.
